name: Golden Designs Kaskinen 6-Person Full Spectrum Hybrid Outdoor Sauna
description: Golden Designs Kaskinen 6-Person Full Spectrum PureTech Hybrid Outdoor Sauna The Kaskinen full-spectrum sauna can accommodate up to 6 individuals and boasts an all-weather exterior and Canadian red cedar interior. Equipped with a total of 15 IR emitters, including 7 carbon PureTech near-zero EMF heating panels and 8 near-infrared heating elements, this sauna provides a holistic and comfortable heat experience. To further enhance relaxation and wellness, the sauna also features an interior ceiling galaxy star color therapy lighting system. Golden Designs outdoor Hybrid (Traditional Stove or Full Spectrum Infrared) saunas provide a healthier way to live. Enjoy the wealth of health benefits a traditional or full-spectrum infrared sauna brings to your life. Take the first step to a healthier life! Features Delivery: This item will be delivered curbside only on a pallet by a freight carrier. Capacity: Full 6-person capacity Stove: 8.0 kW Stove with built-in controls Full Spectrum IR: Total 15 IR Emitters. 7 Carbon PureTech™ Near Zero EMF Heating Panels and 8 Near Infrared Heating Elements Wood Type: All Weather Exterior with all Natural Canadian Red Cedar Interior Glass: Bronze Privacy Tempered glass door Interior Lighting: Interior ceiling galaxy star color therapy lighting system Interior backrest with accent light Control Panels: Interior LED Control Panel with built-in FM Station and Bluetooth Connection Sound System: Built-in Performance Speakers Accessories: Sandglass, bucket, and scoop Temperature Range: Traditional Stove: 170-185 is the ideal temperature range, sauna can heat up to 190F; Full Spectrum IR: 118-132 is the ideal temperature range, sauna can heat up to 140F Electrical service: 240V / 40AMP (Stove) and 120V / 15AMP (Control for Lights and Music) (Please consult a certified electrician.) Location: Outdoor Use Includes Harvia Stove 8KW Traditional Sauna Stove with Built-in Controls Built-in Performance Speakers Sandglass, bucket, and scoop Specifications Exterior Dimensions (WDH) 69" x 84" x 95" (Add 4” around for roof overhang) Interior Dimensions (WDH) 63" x 78" x 88" Sauna Weight 1600 lbs. Shipping Weight 1795 lbs Assembly & Maintenance Assembly Hassle-free assembly , for full details please refer to the Product Manual . Maintenance Since infrared saunas do not require hot rocks, water, or steam to operate, they require very little maintenance. You can simply wipe it down with water - use a damp, soft, and clean cloth. Do not use any chemical-based cleaning agents as they can be absorbed into the wood and released into your sauna during use. Warranty 5-Year Limited Warranty: Golden Designs, Inc. under the Dynamic brand name warranties the wood, structure, heating elements, and electronics against defects in material and workmanship from the original date of purchase. Shipping & Returns This item will be delivered curbside only on a pallet by a freight carrier. If your item(s) do arrive damaged please send photos to customercare@nordicasauna.com and we will process an insurance claim on your behalf.
